description: This file contains example code demonstrating how to use Spark SQL data sources, including reading and writing various data formats (parquet, json, csv, text, jdbc, xml) with different options and configurations.

methods.name: generic_file_source_options_example
methods.description: Demonstrates options for reading files with Spark, including ignoring corrupt files, recursive lookup, glob filtering, and time-based filtering.

methods.name: basic_datasource_example
methods.description: Shows how to load, save, partition, bucket, and run SQL on various data sources like parquet, json, csv, and orc.

methods.name: parquet_example
methods.description: Illustrates reading and writing Parquet files, including creating and querying Parquet datasets.

methods.name: parquet_schema_merging_example
methods.description: Demonstrates schema merging when reading partitioned Parquet datasets with different schemas.

methods.name: json_dataset_example
methods.description: Shows reading JSON data, creating views, and querying with SQL.

methods.name: csv_dataset_example
methods.description: Shows reading CSV files with options like delimiter and header, and writing CSV files.

methods.name: text_dataset_example
methods.description: Demonstrates reading text files with options for line separator and whole text, and writing text files with compression.

methods.name: jdbc_dataset_example
methods.description: Shows reading from and writing to JDBC sources with options for custom schemas and column types.

methods.name: xml_dataset_example
methods.description: Demonstrates reading XML data with specified row tags and creating views for SQL queries.
